name: paper-to-blog
description: Create accessible, source-faithful blog versions of research papers from local PDFs or arXiv URLs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn papers into clear, faithful blog posts.
interface.longDescription: Paper to Blog explains a research paper's problem, core idea, evidence, tradeoffs, and significance for a broader audience. It accepts local PDFs and arXiv links and keeps claims grounded in the inspected source.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this PDF or arXiv paper into a clear, source-faithful blog version.
